audit.whatIsWrong: Five of seven chart rows disagreed with the packet chart and with the page's own prose: Levels 2 and 3 were Skill/Tryndamere where the packet and the text say Renekton ('his most vulnerable window', 'your Q heal keeps you topped up'); Levels 4-5, 6 and first item were Tryndamere/Renekton/Tryndamere where the packet and text all describe a skill stage ('trade short', 'bait R out first', 'keep engages short'). The `diff` enum also read HARD while diffRating is 4/10, the tone is the green band and report[14] calls it a favoured matchup.
audit.why: Tryndamere has no defensive tool before 6, so the early levels are Renekton's; from 4-5 onward Undying Rage makes every all-in conditional, which is a skill stage, not a loss.
audit.corrected: Levels 2 and 3 to Renekton (7/10), Levels 4-5 to Skill (5/10), Level 6 to Skill (5/10), first item to Skill (5/10) in both layers as one atomic group; diff set to FAV.

audit.why: Levels 2-3, level 6 Undying Rage, first crit item, and full crit at two items — four spikes and they track his actual power curve.
audit.corrected: phases[4].why rewritten so the level-6 row states why it is skill rather than a free Dominus win.

audit.whatIsWrong: Mocking Shout is described only as a slow that makes chasing dangerous. Riot's text: it lowers the attack damage of surrounding champions, and slows ONLY enemies whose backs are turned to him. That condition appears nowhere on the page.
audit.why: It is a positioning rule you can act on — face him while you disengage and the slow never applies, which decides whether the post-R chase kills you.
audit.corrected: Facing condition written into breakdown.cooldowns, report[5].t, phases[3].why and wants.foe[2].

audit.whatIsWrong: No cooldowns anywhere, despite the entire plan being 'bait R, then kill'.
audit.why: Undying Rage is 120s at rank 1 — exactly the same as Dominus — Bloodlust 12s, Mocking Shout 14s, Spinning Slash 12s at rank 1.
audit.corrected: Numbers written into breakdown.cooldowns, dosFull[0].d, report[5].t, phases[1].why and phases[4].why.

audit.why: report[8].t already prescribes Executioner's Calling early; the Bloodlust cooldown is now named so the item has a concrete target.

audit.whatIsWrong: Packet flagged 'Pop Undying Rage' and 'His Mocking Shout' as probable wrong names.
audit.why: Both are false positives — real R and W names.

edits.before: E-in trades begin — bank 50 fury before you slice. Only take the trade when Tryndamere's Undying Rage is down.
edits.after: E-in trades begin — bank 50 fury and stun him now, while Bloodlust is 12s and Undying Rage does not exist yet.

edits.before: Full kit online — your core pattern starts now. Keep the wave near your side so Tryndamere must walk into your engage range.
edits.after: Full kit online — stand between him and his tower so Spinning Slash cannot reposition him past you, then run the pattern.

edits.before: The lane-control window: trade around Undying Rage's cooldown and bank small leads. If ahead, freeze and deny; if behind, farm safe.
edits.after: He has R now and crit is climbing — keep trades short, deny Bloodlust, and never turn your back or Mocking Shout slows you.

edits.before: Dominus stats turn even fights into wins before 25 minutes. Reassess every all-in at 6 — Tryndamere's ultimate changes the math too.
edits.after: Dominus does not beat Undying Rage — bait the R with a short trade, then commit in the window after it drops. Both are 120s.

edits.before: Eclipse is your spike — force fights the moment it completes, on Undying Rage's cooldown.
edits.after: Eclipse helps, but his first crit item makes every extended trade dangerous — stay short.

edits.before: - Tryndamere Undying Rage: matchup-defining — Unkillable 5s. Burst him before he R’s. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Tryndamere Undying Rage: 120s at rank 1 — bait it with a short trade, then kill in the window after it drops. - Bloodlust: 12s heal, so anti-heal lands before you commit. - Mocking Shout: 14s, and it only slows you if your back is turned.

edits.before: Unkillable 5s. Burst him before he R’s. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: Unkillable while it runs, and 120s at rank 1 — bait it, then kill after.

edits.before: Track Tryndamere's Undying Rage: Unkillable 5s. Burst him before he R’s. When it is down — W-stun + Q him.
edits.after: Mocking Shout slows only if your back is turned — face him. Undying Rage is 120s: bait it, then commit.

edits.before: Spin-kite you with Spinning Slash (E) repositioning and Mocking Shout (W) slow after R expires to run out the clock
edits.after: Spin away with Spinning Slash and catch you turned, since Mocking Shout only slows enemies whose backs face him

notes: Two things to flag. The `diff` enum said HARD while diffRating (4/10), the tone colour and report[14] ('Favoured matchup') all said the opposite — set to FAV; if the intent was that the 49.47% win rate makes this hard, then diffRating and report[14] are the fields to change instead and this edit should be dropped. Five chart rows were moved onto the packet chart, which also matches the prose. The unstated mechanic was Mocking Shout slowing only enemies with their backs turned. 'Unkillable 5s' was left as written — the duration is not in Riot's kit text, so I neither confirmed nor changed it. Mirror tryndamere__renekton not yet audited.
